label: Figure 4.8: An Engel curve for instant noodles
alt: An Engel curve with income on the horizontal axis and quantity of instant noodles demanded on the vertical axis. It rises, peaks and then falls at higher incomes.
caption: An Engel curve for instant noodles. At low incomes, quantity demanded rises steeply as income rises (a normal good). Demand peaks at income Y* and then falls as households can afford superior alternatives, so beyond Y* instant noodles behave as an inferior good.
